pages.text: "Mom, let's see that shiny thing!" Dari pointed at a market stall as soon as they landed. Fish and shellfish shops lined the way. Mom said, "Stay close. If you lose me, stop and call loudly."
A shell necklace glittered between people. Dari slipped away. "Beautiful!" He stood right before it. Meanwhile, the crowd hid Mom from view.
After looking, Dari turned—no Mom! Strange tails and legs surrounded him. His heart thumped and his eyes filled with tears.
Then Mom's words returned. "If you lose me, stop right there!" Dari stayed put instead of running around and took a big breath. "I can do this."
Next: "Stop and call Mom loudly!" Dari filled his tummy with air. "Mom! Dari's here!" People at the market turned one by one.
Mom hurried through the crowd. "Dari!" "Mom!" He nestled into her arms. She stroked his back gently.
Mom held her tail out before him. "Hold tight as we go. Stay close to Mom!" Dari gripped it in both front flippers and repeated the words.
Holding her tail, Dari passed fish, shellfish, and glittering necklace stalls. However shiny they were, he didn't let go. Happily, he slapped his own tail.
Now Dari knew three steps. "One, stop right there! Two, call Mom loudly! Three, hold Mom's tail tight!" Mom put a shell necklace around his neck.
Mom hugged him. "So brave to stop and call!" Even after losing her, stopping and calling had reunited them. "Stay close to Mom!" The shell necklace shone.
